title: Trust-store LRU eviction can flush replay windows, enabling replay poisoning
description: Security-pass note from project-LICHEN-worker6-lzgc review (pre-existing). spec/02-physical-link.md:296-299: the SIID-indexed trust store is a 256-entry LRU, and replay state (Epoch/SeqNum windows) lives with the pinned (SIID, key) binding. An attacker injecting 256 distinct signer identities can evict a victim's entry, invalidating its replay window — then replay the victim's old signed frames (e.g., SOS) since the window reset accepts stale SeqNums; evicted entries also reset per-source rate-limit/reputation state keyed on the same identity (12-apps.md §18.4.1). Decide: pin replay-window state separately from the evictable trust store, raise the floor for critical peers (DODAG root, SOS origins), or accept and document the ceiling in 06-security.md DoS analysis (coordinate nqz6.3.3).
